spans.s:
श्येत श्येत, अस्, ता or श्येनी, अम् (probably
connected with श्वेत), white, of a white colour;
(अस्), m. white (the colour).
—श्येत-कोलक, अस्,
[]
m. the Saphara fish, Cyprinus Saphore (commonly
called Puṃṭī).

श्येन, अस्, m. white (the colour); whiteness,
paleness; a hawk, falcon, bird of prey; ‘hawk-like
conduct,’ violence; a horse (Ved.); a particular sacri-
ficial ceremony or imprecatory rite; N. of a Vedic
Ṛṣi (author of the hymn Ṛg-veda

); (ई),
f. white, (see above under श्येत); a female hawk;
N. of a daughter of Kaśyapa (regarded as the mother
of hawks); a woman (described as resembling a
lily-leaf); a species of the Tṛṣṭubh metre.
—श्येन-
कपोतीय, अम्, n. the story of the hawk and
pigeon; [cf. शिवि.]
—श्येन-करण, अम्, n. or
श्येन-करणिका, f. acting like a hawk (i. e. rashly
or desperately); burning on a separate funeral pile.
—श्येन-घण्टा, f. a kind of plant (= दन्ती).
—श्येन-चित्, त्, m. a hawk-feeder, hawk-keeper,
falconer; a receptacle shaped like a hawk (for sacri-
ficial fire &c.)
—श्येन-जित्, त्, m. a proper N.
—श्येनजिद्-आख्यान, अम्, n., N. of an episode in
the Mahā-bhārata.
—श्येन-जीविन्, ई, m. one who
lives by selling or training hawks, a falconer.
—श्ये-
न-पत्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. going like a hawk or
going as fast as a horse.
—श्येनोपदेश (˚न-उप्˚),
अस्, m. recommendation or injunction to women to
burn on a separate funeral pile.
श्येनिका, f. a kind of metre.
